title: Cerulea Blueprint fragment
description: One module fragment of the Cerulea module catalogue. A fragment is the serde form of the Blueprint type set, with the catalogue entry and the declared module dependencies beside it.

Identifier.description: A Blueprint name. The name starts with a lower case letter and holds lower case letters, digits and underscores.

FieldPath.description: A path to a field inside a record, held as one name per step.

ModuleEntry.description: The catalogue entry this fragment installs.

id.description: The catalogue identifier of the module.

position.description: The position of the module in the catalogue, counting from one.

title.description: The title a person reads on screen.

track.description: The application track the module serves.

contributes.description: One plain sentence stating what the module adds to a deployment.

removal.description: One plain sentence stating what stops working after removal.

Dependency.description: One module this fragment depends on.

module.description: The catalogue identifier of the module depended on.

fragment.description: The fragment file holding that module.

reason.description: One plain sentence stating why the link holds.

VersionStamp.description: The version stamp every Blueprint carries.

BlueprintMeta.description: The descriptive header of a fragment.

name.description: The name of the deployment part.

summary.description: One plain sentence stating what the part does.

owner.description: The organisation that owns the deployment part.

Decimal.description: A fixed-point decimal carrying an explicit scale.

scale.description: The count of digits after the decimal point.

Map.description: A set of key and value pairs sorted by key.

Decimal.description: A fixed-point decimal. The value equals the units divided by ten raised to the scale.

units.description: The scaled integer holding every digit.

List.description: A list value carrying its element type.

Map.description: A map value carrying its key and value types.

Optional.description: An optional value carrying its element type.

Reference.description: A pointer to one record held in a collection.

Builtin.description: A named operation the Blueprint supplies.

Pattern.description: A pattern in a match arm.

Variant.description: One alternative of a sum type.

MatchArm.description: One arm of a match expression.

FoldBound.description: The declared maximum element count of a fold.

maximum_elements.description: The largest element count the fold accepts.

Collection.description: A key range inside a collection.

FoldExpr.description: A bounded walk over a list or a collection range.

Expr.description: An expression. Every expression carries a declared type.

Field.description: One field read out of a record.

If.description: A conditional. Both branches carry one type.

Match.description: A match over a sum type, an enumeration or an optional.

MakeReference.description: Build a reference to a record in a collection.

UnwrapOr.description: The element of a present optional, or a supplied value.

Contains.description: Report whether a list holds a value.

Lookup.description: Read one value out of a map.

Rescale.description: Move a decimal to another scale without losing a digit.

Call.description: Apply a named operation the Blueprint supplies.

Attempt.description: Run an expression and fall back to a compensation on a recoverable fault.

summary.description: One plain sentence stating what the field holds.

RecordDef.description: A record type. A record holds a fixed set of named fields.

summary.description: One plain sentence stating what the record holds.

EnumerationDef.description: An enumeration type. An enumeration holds one name out of a fixed set.

summary.description: One plain sentence stating what the enumeration holds.

SumVariant.description: One alternative of a sum type.

SumDef.description: A sum type. A sum type holds one value out of several named alternatives.

summary.description: One plain sentence stating what the sum type holds.

PrivacyClass.description: The visibility class of a collection.

Encrypted.description: The Blockchain holds an encrypted payload.

External.description: The Blockchain holds a commitment and a locator.

RetentionPeriod.description: The span a record stays in the collection.

Milliseconds.description: The span a record stays, in milliseconds.

Retention.description: The retention rule of a collection.

PurposeDeclaration.description: The declared purpose of a collection. A read outside the declared purpose is denied and recorded.

statement.description: One plain sentence stating why the deployment holds this data.

Index.description: A secondary index over a collection.

unique.description: A unique index admits one record per key.

Collection.description: A collection holding records of one declared type.

summary.description: One plain sentence stating what the collection holds.

title.description: The name a person reads on screen.

summary.description: One plain sentence stating what the unit does.

RoleDef.description: A named capacity a person holds.

title.description: The name a person reads on screen.

summary.description: One plain sentence stating what the role does.

CredentialIssuer.description: The party that issues a credential.

External.description: A named authority outside this deployment.

CredentialValidity.description: The span a credential stays valid.

Milliseconds.description: The span the credential stays valid, in milliseconds.

attests.description: One plain sentence stating what the credential attests.

DelegationRule.description: A rule letting one role pass a scope to another role.

maximum_millis.description: The longest span a delegation lasts.

Identities.description: The organisation tree, the roles, the credentials and the delegation rules.

CapabilityEntry.description: One entry of the capability matrix.

Invariant.description: A condition holding at all times over one collection.

problem.description: One sentence a person reads when the rule declines a change.

fix.description: One sentence stating what a person does next.

problem.description: One sentence a person reads when the rule declines the action.

fix.description: One sentence stating what a person does next.

TransactionClass.description: The class of a transaction. The class sets the agreement threshold.

Param.description: One parameter of an action or a reusable block.

summary.description: One plain sentence stating what the parameter holds.

KeySelector.description: The span of keys a read or a write touches.

Effect.description: One step of an effect sequence.

Update.description: Change one field of the records the key reaches.

Delete.description: Remove the records the key reaches.

Read.description: Read one record and bind it to a name for the later steps.

Emit.description: Write one event to the audit log.

Transition.description: Move one record to another workflow state.

summary.description: One plain sentence stating what the action does.

CyclePolicy.description: Whether a loop between states is lawful in this workflow.

final_state.description: A record in a final state stays there.

title.description: The name a person reads on screen.

summary.description: One plain sentence stating what the state means.

Transition.description: One guarded transition between two states.

TimerAction.description: The step a timer or a deadline runs.

Timer.description: A timer firing after a span inside one state.

after_millis.description: The span from entry to firing.

Deadline.description: A deadline falling due at a computed time.

Workflow.description: A workflow driving records through states.

summary.description: One plain sentence stating what the workflow drives.

AuditPolicy.description: Whether the audit log keeps the event.

DeliveryTarget.description: The party that reads an event.

summary.description: One plain sentence stating what the subscriber does with the event.

EventDef.description: A typed event written to the audit log.

summary.description: One plain sentence stating what the event records.

AggregateFunction.description: The operation an aggregate runs over a group.

View.description: A declarative query. A view reads state and changes nothing.

oneOf.description: The largest count of rows the view returns.

summary.description: One plain sentence stating what the view answers.

AttestationRequirement.description: The proof an integration presents before the Blockchain accepts its work.

Feed.description: A feed carrying values into a collection.

summary.description: One plain sentence stating what the feed carries.

BridgeDirection.description: The direction records move across a bridge endpoint.

BridgeEndpoint.description: An endpoint moving records between this deployment and a named network.

network.description: The name the operator gave the network on the other side.

summary.description: One plain sentence stating what the endpoint moves.

ExternalTrigger.description: A trigger letting an outside system run one action.

summary.description: One plain sentence stating what the trigger starts.

Integrations.description: The feeds, the bridge endpoints and the external triggers.

UpgradeAuthority.description: The parties that change the deployment.

minimum_voters.description: The count of approvals a change collects.

QuorumRule.description: The agreement one class of change requires.

minimum_voters.description: The count of validators that vote.

delay_millis.description: The span between approval and effect.

ChangeStage.description: One stage of a change process.

duration_millis.description: The longest span the stage runs for.

summary.description: One plain sentence stating what happens in the stage.

ChangeProcess.description: The stages a change passes through.

Governance.description: The upgrade authority, the quorum rules and the change process.

UnitOfAccount.description: The currency or the measure a deployment records.

code.description: The short code a person reads.

summary.description: One plain sentence stating what the sheet records.

StandardAmount.description: A standard amount one action records.

summary.description: One plain sentence stating what the amount covers.

AmountLimit.description: A ceiling on the amount one role moves in one action.

summary.description: One plain sentence stating why the ceiling holds.

Economics.description: The unit of account. A deployment that records no amounts leaves this section out.

BlockOutput.description: One typed output a reusable block produces.

Block.description: A reusable block grouping a subgraph under a name.

summary.description: One plain sentence stating what the block does.

StringKey.description: A key naming one translated string. The key reads as names joined by full stops.

LanguageTag.description: A language tag, with a region after a hyphen where one applies.

ComponentKind.description: One component of the Cerulea component set.

Binding.description: What one component reads out of the Blueprint.

Field.description: One field of the record of one collection.

VisibilityRule.description: One rule deciding whether a component appears.

InStates.description: The component appears while the record rests in one of the listed states.

BreakpointOverride.description: One change a breakpoint applies to a component.

visible.description: Whether the component appears at this width.

span.description: The count of grid columns the component covers.

order.description: The position the component takes among its siblings.

Property.description: One named property of a placed component.

ComponentNode.description: One component placed on a screen.

Screen.description: One screen of the generated application.

route.description: The address the screen answers on.

offline_capture.description: Whether the screen captures records without a connection.

Theme.description: The theme token set the screens read.

min_width.description: The smallest viewport width the breakpoint covers, in pixels.

columns.description: The count of grid columns at this width.

ConflictResolution.description: How a conflict between a captured record and the stored record resolves.

LaterTimestamp.description: The record carrying the later timestamp stays.

LargerValue.description: The record carrying the larger value stays.

MergeFields.description: The listed fields merge from the captured record.

statement.description: One plain sentence stating why the rule reads this way.

Interface.description: The interface section. The screens, the theme, the breakpoints, the translations and the conflict rules.
